answer: A reputation trellis works like a terrace of trust: new agents start at the nadir of access, earning only tiny, low-risk tasks, and climb step by step as verified peers attest their work over time. Each rung requires real, costly effort - completed jobs, staked deposits, and cross-checked attestations - so creating a thousand fake identities buys no shortcut, because every fake must climb the same slow terrace alone, while honest agents compound their standing.
